name: klog-a98c03ed-blind30-ots
instr:
# Plain-text time-logging CLI: wrong numbers and wrong layout all over, without a test suite

This is a command-line tool for keeping a work journal in plain text files, and it now gets a great many things wrong. The file format has not changed and the files themselves are untouched, but the same invocations that used to give correct answers give wrong ones, and in a couple of places something that used to be left alone on disk is quietly altered. The repository has received 30 separate undocumented edits.

Getting the tool to look at anything at all is the first trouble. Invoking a command without naming a file no longer falls back to the saved default location: the call comes back with nothing. An argument consisting only of blank spaces is now taken for a genuine path rather than being disregarded the way an empty argument is, so that same fallback fails for it too. Feeding content in on the standard input stream is broken outright as well — the text is read, but the caller is given no content back.

What you type into a journal by hand is read back wrongly in several places. Text that is not a well-formed clock value — things like 009:42, 09:042, 13:3, or outright gibberish — is no longer turned away consistently; some such text now comes back as an accepted clock value instead of drawing a malformed-value complaint.
